items.issue: This is the same Short content as short-019 and an edited excerpt of quark-live-046.

items.issue: The speaker presents a fixed chain of what women supposedly infer from people-pleasing.
items.disposition: Treat it as his interpretation, not established psychology or a rule for reading another person's motives.

items.issue: The clip compares a person who pleases others to a dog or non-person.
items.disposition: Do not reproduce or normalize the dehumanizing comparison as guidance.

items.issue: Terms such as command, leadership and control can be misread as permission to dominate another person.
items.disposition: Limit any summary to self-control and calmness; it grants no authority over another person.
